_readme: The drawer's type and geometry contract, as NAMES rather than literal sizes.
Home's contract keys roles by the literal string each Text renders; the drawer
keeps every size in DrawerMetrics on both platforms, so a literal-based scanner
would read the style's base size instead of the shipped one. This file lists the
metric names each platform must define IDENTICALLY, and the labels each platform
Regenerate the metric list with --derive after adding a role.
